map.儿童BMI的正常范围随年龄和性别变化，因此不能用成人标准直接判断。BMI百分位是: The normal range of child BMI changes with age and sex, so adult standards cannot be used directly. BMI percentile compares a child's BMI with other children of the same age and sex to assess growth and development. Tracking changes in a child's BMI percentile over time is more meaningful than a single measurement.

map.Input: 年龄 10 岁、身高 140 cm、体重 35 kg。\nBMI:
Input: age 10, height 140 cm, weight 35 kg. 
 BMI = 35 ÷ (1.40²) = 35 ÷ 1.96 = 17.86. 
 Compared with the 10-year-old same-sex reference curve: P5 ≈ 16.5, P85 ≈ 21.5, P95 ≈ 25.0. 
 Conclusion: measured BMI 17.86 falls in P5-P85 (normal range), a healthy weight; if ≥ P85 overweight, ≥ P95 obese, judged with the growth curve.

map.儿童 BMI 能直接用成人的 18.5/24 标准吗？: Can child BMI use the adult 18.5/24 standard directly?
map.不能。儿童处于发育期，BMI 随年龄性别变化，须用「年龄别 BMI 百分位」：<: No. Children are developing; BMI changes with age and sex and must use 'age-specific BMI percentile': <P5 underweight, P5-P85 normal, P85-P95 overweight, ≥P95 obese. Adult fixed cutoffs severely misjudge.
map.百分位下降（变瘦）要担心吗？: Should a falling percentile (getting thinner) be a worry?
map.单次波动意义有限，重点看「跨百分位线」趋势。若 BMI 百分位持续下滑穿过 P5: A single fluctuation is of limited meaning; the key is the 'crossing percentile line' trend. If BMI percentile keeps falling across P5 or clearly drops from its own baseline, check nutrition, digestion/absorption and endocrine issues, not just a single value.
